name: Andaz Mayakoba Resort Riviera Maya
positioning: Wellness-focused resort in Mayakoba on the Riviera Maya, now operating as Alila Mayakoba, with a lively beach side and a quieter lagoon side
best_for: Travelers who want a suite or villa with a private plunge pool
Wellness seekers drawn to Mayan-inspired spa rituals and cenote ceremonies

facts.text: The resort sits within the verdant sanctuary of Mayakoba on the Riviera Maya and is positioned as a wellness retreat.
Alila Mayakoba is made up of two distinct but connected resort experiences, The Beach and The Lagoon.
Mayakoba sits about five miles north of Playa del Carmen.
Beachfront studios offer Caribbean views and a plunge pool on a private balcony or small terrace.
Lagoon-area rooms with a plunge pool have a balcony with a private plunge pool and views of the lagoon or garden.
Wellness spaces include a fitness center with Peloton bikes and an authentic temescal steam lodge.
The Earth and Clay ritual uses mineral-rich clay and honey and ends with an ocean immersion.
The off-property Winds of Renewal ritual includes a Mayan water blessing at an open cenote.
The resort can arrange snorkeling over coral reefs, private dining on the sand or sailing.
Excursions take guests to villages and ancient ruins beyond the resort.
Casa Amate is a restaurant in a historic lagoon-side house that was once the De Leon family residence, serving Latin American cuisine.
Na Cocina Local serves Yucatan cuisine from an open kitchen beside the lagoon.

highlights.text: The Lagoon side is a quieter, nature-led wellness retreat among the mangroves, home to Spa Alila.
The Beach side has a social, lively mood anchored by a beach club, a taqueria and oceanfront dining.
With traditional healers and spiritual guides, the resort offers cenote immersions, guided ceremonies and energy cleansings rooted in Mayan spirituality.
Spa Alila is inspired by Mayan cosmology and guided by the sacred Tzolk'in.
The Beach Front Villa spans two floors with nature-inspired decor and a private terrace with a plunge pool and beachfront views.

considerations.text: Cancun International Airport is about 28 miles away.
Alila Moments rituals carry an additional cost.
Outdoor wellness sessions are subject to weather conditions.
